snippet.query: What is a white-label telecom reseller?
snippet.exactText: A white-label telecom reseller sells connectivity under its own brand while an upstream provider supplies the network services and supporting platform. The reseller’s commercial responsibility depends on its agreement: branding alone does not establish who bills customers, handles complaints, funds refunds or carries a minimum purchase commitment.
